title: Current qualification and negative controls
summary: v0.6 passed the inherited stream/datagram/seqpacket, abstract/pathname/unnamed address, poll/nonblocking, descriptor/credential, filesystem-safety and ABI-profile suites under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 with source-rebuilt Foreign Runtime v0.22.6.
invariants: Release qualification includes an independent compiled C-header forcing probe for 67 profile constants and six struct layouts.
A separate 18-assertion Rexx forcing test checks the actual ABI-native method/field declarations.
The mismatched ABI test must reject before dlopen.
Release tests must fail if a dedicated librxunixsocket.so or old rxunixsocket native requirement reappears.
Vulkan hardware skip in Foreign Runtime qualification is unrelated to Unix Socket semantics and does not weaken the socket qualification claim.
procedure: Before sealing a successor, rerun the complete Unix Socket suite from a fresh extraction against the exact intended Foreign Runtime and ooRexx runtime.

provenance.claim: Qualification records the complete v0.6 semantic regression result and narrowed portability claim.
